summary: Reproduced that the real legacy host-affinity PD chat route completed successfully without emitting sgl_router_decode_affinity_total. The fix carries the selected affinity branch through the current decode policy/admission pipeline and records it only when that proposal is the final decode worker. It also preserves breaker-fallback observability by classifying against the registered decode pool while selecting only from eligible workers. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32753 contains an earlier fix for the pre-policy-pipeline route, but remains open and does not apply directly to this base.

tests.what_was_measured: Real Axum /v1/chat/completions path with mock prefill/decode workers: successful PD routing produced no decode-affinity sample; plain mode and an empty decode pool correctly produced none. Raw output: /job/reports/j-de6e1c36e1bf/raw/failing-before.log

Four HTTP-route regressions: same-host selection increments once, breaker fallback increments once, plain mode does not increment, and NoDecodeWorkersAvailable does not increment. Raw output: /job/reports/j-de6e1c36e1bf/raw/proxy-tests-final.log

Fifteen resolver/selection tests, including independent same-host, missing-host, malformed URL, load imbalance, breaker, empty-pool, and all-breakers-open boundaries. Raw output: /job/reports/j-de6e1c36e1bf/raw/registry-tests-final.log
Twenty-two metric registry tests, including rendering all four decode-affinity outcome labels. Raw output: /job/reports/j-de6e1c36e1bf/raw/metrics-tests-final.log
Rust formatting for the router workspace. Raw output: /job/reports/j-de6e1c36e1bf/raw/cargo-fmt-check.log
Compilation of all router targets with the repository-pinned Rust 1.90 toolchain. Raw output: /job/reports/j-de6e1c36e1bf/raw/cargo-check-all-targets-final.log
Blocked by a pre-existing clippy::nonminimal_bool warning in src/policies/buckets.rs:167, outside the changed paths. Raw output: /job/reports/j-de6e1c36e1bf/raw/cargo-clippy-all-targets.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and regression are entirely in experimental/sgl-router CPU-side HTTP routing and Prometheus accounting. No model kernels, weights, or GPU output are involved.

remaining_limitations: Validation used the repository's deterministic in-process HTTP mock workers, not a live model deployment; it qualifies router transport, selection, and metric accounting only.
No GPU was used because GPU execution is not on this observability code path.
The full clippy -D warnings gate remains blocked by the unrelated existing warning in experimental/sgl-router/src/policies/buckets.rs:167.
